description: This file defines the 'Prospect' class, which models a prospect entity in the SuiteCRM system. It extends a generic Person class and implements email-related interface features. The class includes properties for prospect fields, methods for building search clauses, converting prospects, retrieving target lists, and other CRM-related functionalities.

classes.name: Prospect
classes.description: Represents a CRM prospect with fields related to personal and contact information, and methods for search, conversion, and data retrieval operations.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Fills in additional fields for list view, including proper name creation and email display.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Fills in additional fields for detail view, including proper name creation.

methods.name: build_generic_where_clause
methods.description: Constructs a SQL WHERE clause for search queries based on a given query string.

methods.name: converted_prospect
methods.description: Converts the prospect to a contact, updating associated IDs.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Checks if the bean implements a given interface, such as ACL.

methods.name: retrieveTargetList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of target prospects based on a query for use in mail merges or other batch operations.

methods.name: retrieveTarget
methods.description: Retrieves a specific target entity related to the prospect by ID.

methods.name: get_unlinked_email_query
methods.description: Returns a query to find unlinked email addresses related to the prospect.
